ns2:course.label: Fundamental Mathematics-ACP
ns2:course.description: Course is identical to MATH 347 except for the additional writing component. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Credit is not given for both MATH 348 and MATH 347. Prerequisite: MATH 231 and completion of the campus COMPOSITION I general education requirement.
